description: This file defines a class 'CoreBuildFontResolver_REMOVE' implementing the 'IFontResolver' interface. It provides mechanisms to resolve and load fonts based on font family names, with platform-specific handling for Windows and Linux. The class includes internal data structures for font face information, including font names, file paths, and font styles or simulations, along with methods to resolve typefaces and load font data from system directories.

classes.name: CoreBuildFontResolver_REMOVE
classes.description: Implements font resolving logic for the core build environment, providing font resolution based on font family names and platform specifics.

classes.name: TypefaceInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a particular typeface, including font face name, simulation style, filenames for Windows and Linux, and substitute face names.

classes.name: TypefaceInfo.FontSimulation
classes.description: Flag enum representing font styles such as None, Bold, Italic, or both.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves a font family name to a platform-specific font resolver info, considering bold and italic styles.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Returns font data as byte array based on the face name, platform-specific.

methods.name: GetWindowsFontFace
methods.description: Loads font file bytes from Windows font directories if available.

methods.name: GetLinuxFontFace
methods.description: Loads font file bytes from Linux font directories.

methods.name: FindFileRecursive
methods.description: Recursively searches for a font file matching the face name within a directory and its subdirectories.

methods.name: FaceNameToFilenameCandidates
methods.description: Generates a list of possible font filenames for Linux systems based on the face name and known font families.
